sports.headline: Kimi Antonelli becomes youngest F1 world champion as Verstappen wins Mexico City GP
sports.summary: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli clinched his maiden title by finishing third in Mexico City, at 20 years and 68 days. Max Verstappen won the race, 0.8s ahead of Lewis Hamilton. A major generational shift at the top of F1.

sports.headline: Alexander Zverev becomes ATP world No. 1 as Paris Masters opens without Sinner
sports.summary: Zverev started the Paris Masters on the day he rose to world No. 1. Defending champion Jannik Sinner has ended his season with a knee injury. Carlos Alcaraz is in the draw, and the tournament is the last Masters 1000 before the ATP Finals in Turin.

sports.headline: NFL and TMRW Sports unveil pro flag football league for men and women ahead of LA 2028
sports.summary: A new professional flag football league will launch the summer before the sport's Olympic debut at the 2028 Los Angeles Games. USA Football women's stars Ashlea Klam and Izzy Geraci have signed on as ambassadors. The aim is to let players be paid full-time.

sports.headline: Mark Walter explores sale of Cadillac F1 team stake at $3bn+ valuation
sports.summary: Sportico reports Walter's TWG Global is shopping the Cadillac F1 team with an asking price of at least $3bn and at least seven interested parties. This follows his reported moves to sell the Lakers and Chelsea. Bloomberg says buyers are circling but no deal has been agreed.

fashion.headline: CFDA Fashion Awards 2026: Rachel Scott (Diotima) wins Womenswear Designer of the Year, Ralph Lauren takes Menswear
fashion.summary: The awards were held at the American Museum of Natural History, hosted by Keke Palmer, with Anna Wintour and Matt Damon among the presenters. Rachel Scott won Womenswear Designer of the Year for Diotima and Ralph Lauren won Menswear. Saint Laurent's Anthony Vaccarello was honoured as International Designer of the Year.

fashion.headline: Burberry taps Pierce Brosnan, Fiona Shaw and Wu Lei for 170th-anniversary festive campaign
fashion.summary: WWD's exclusive reveals 'Wrapped in Burberry: Celebrating 170 Years', set at Longleat House in Wiltshire. It is part of the brand's yearlong anniversary celebrations and features Brosnan and Shaw as hosts.

fashion.headline: Bangladesh sets up garment wage board after unrest shuts more than 500 factories
fashion.summary: Violent protests over pay forced the closure of more than 500 factories over the weekend. The government responded by forming a wage board. It is a major supply-chain story for global fashion brands.

fashion.headline: Ralph Lauren expands holiday experience to seven global cities
fashion.summary: This year's Adirondacks-themed campaign brings Lake House-style retreats, ice rinks and Ralph's Coffee pop-ups to London, Tokyo, Seoul, Sydney, Hong Kong, Singapore and Los Angeles. London's Sloane Square installation opens 12 November.

marketing.headline: Publicis completes LiveRamp takeover and says Omnicom and WPP are still 'welcome' to use it
marketing.summary: Campaign reports the takeover has completed. LiveRamp CEO Scott Howe will receive a golden parachute of up to $32.5m, even though shareholders opposed it in an advisory vote. This is a major adtech and holding-company power move.

marketing.headline: Droga5 global CEO Mark Green dies aged 53
marketing.summary: Green, co-founder of The Monkeys and Droga5 global CEO since 2024, died of a heart attack on 31 October. Accenture said Droga5's leadership team will ensure continuity for staff and clients. The news is a significant leadership loss for the global agency industry.

marketing.headline: Svedka's divisive AI ad earns a Super Bowl sequel as it invites fans to make its 2027 spot
marketing.summary: Svedka is returning to the Super Bowl with a contest calling on fans to make its ad, promoting its new Vodka Water. Parent Sazerac credits rapid sales growth partly to last February's polarising commercial.

marketing.headline: UK Christmas ad season kicks off: Argos with Richard Ayoade, Tesco, Aldi's Kevin the Carrot, Lidl and John Lewis teasers
marketing.summary: Argos has enlisted Richard Ayoade for humour in its 2026 Christmas ad, and Tesco has returned to the hero-spot format. Aldi is teasing the return of Kevin the Carrot, while Lidl and John Lewis have released teasers.

marketing.headline: Lebara launches major rebrand with a stop-motion capybara mascot
marketing.summary: Ace of Hearts introduces a laid-back capybara mascot as the UK mobile network tries to build a brand beyond low prices.

marketing.headline: News Alliance #AskForNews campaign targets CMO reluctance to advertise in news media
marketing.summary: Developed by Bountiful Cow's creative team, the campaign will run in mainstream news and trade titles. It aims to persuade marketing chiefs to put ad spend back into news.
